fields: L6 Hong Kong / Mid-Autumn Festival (inline roller skates; Central → Victoria Harbour → The Peak). Same item fields as L3 v3.1 / L4 / L5. Pools keep L3 names so pickSetL2 + l3TypeUniq can be reused: seawall = 月饼摊 Mooncake Stall questions (3–4 choices, timed 30 s; also the retry pool), forest_fork = fork signs (≤3 choices; sign_en/sign_zh must equal choices; EN ≤24 chars, ZH width ≤12 where CJK=1, ASCII=0.5), peak_final = The Peak / 太平山顶 final (exactly 4 choices, hard, situational, no bare arithmetic). Per run: 3 timed stall in segment 1 + 4 fork in segment 2 + 2 timed stall and 1 Peak final in segment 3 = 10 (one stall pool, drawn as 5 then split 3+2; do not place all 5 timed questions in the first segment). Every item has qtype + qtype_zh (each qtype at most once per run). {name} = player name; English on top, Chinese below. No subject capybara/beaver. Festival riddles are object/animal riddles solvable in both languages (subject 'riddle'), labelled Festival riddle: / 中秋谜：. Stems are deduped against all L1–L5 banks (all grades).

questions.qtype_zh: 香港生活（叮叮车/的士/小巴）

questions.subject: science
questions.q_en: On wet stones at the Peak lookout, Flora brakes her skates and needs more room to stop than on a dry Central street. The main reason is ____.
questions.q_zh: 太平山观景台的湿石面上，Flora 刹车要比在干燥的中环街上用更长的距离才能停住。主要原因是____。
choices: lantern light heating the wheels into jets
sound from the harbour pushing her
less friction on the wet surface
choices_zh: 灯光把轮子加热成了喷气装置
questions.explain_en: Water reduces friction, so stopping takes more distance.
questions.explain_zh: 水会减小摩擦，停下就要更长的距离。
questions.qtype_zh: 力与运动（摩擦/阻力/牛顿定律）

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: A bunting curve over the harbour is h(x) = 2x^3. What is its slope h'(1)?
questions.q_zh: 维港一串彩旗的曲线是 h(x) = 2x^3，它在 x = 1 处的斜率 h'(1) 是多少？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: Mooncakes at the Peak are set out at a rate of r(t) = 8t mooncakes per minute for 0 ≤ t ≤ 6. How many mooncakes are set out in total?
questions.q_zh: 太平山的月饼按 r(t) = 8t 块/分钟的速率摆出，0 ≤ t ≤ 6，一共摆出多少块？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: At the Peak, Flora may pick 3 of 7 different mooncakes to share. Order does not matter. How many different sets can she pick?
questions.q_zh: 在太平山，Flora 可以从 7 块不同的月饼里挑 3 块分享，不计顺序，有多少种挑法？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: At the harbour, Flora guesses 4 bank questions, each with a 1/2 chance of being right, independently. What is the probability she gets exactly 1 right?
questions.q_zh: 在维港，Flora 猜 4 道银行题，每道猜对的概率都是 1/2，互不影响。恰好猜对 1 道的概率是多少？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: The harbour's flag rows hold 6, 7, 8 flags and so on, 8 rows in all. How many flags are there in total?
questions.q_zh: 维港彩旗一排比一排多：6、7、8，依此类推，一共 8 排，总共多少面？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: Mooncakes at the Peak are set out in rounds: 6 mooncakes in the first round, then 3 times as many each round, for 4 rounds. How many mooncakes in total?
questions.q_zh: 太平山的月饼分轮摆：第一轮 6 块，之后每轮是上一轮的 3 倍，共 4 轮，一共多少块？
